newsitem.title: USA: Chile's ENAP buys Palanca, Oriente crude for Nov.
newsitem.headline: Chile's ENAP buys Palanca, Oriente crude for Nov.

text.p: Chile's state oil company Empresa Nacional del Petroleo (ENAP) bought a cargo each of Angolan Palanca and Ecuadorian Oriente for November delivery, traders said Thursday.
ENAP took about 985,000 barrels of Palanca crude for November and about 400,000 barrels of Oriente in a purchase tender which closed Wednesday.
Palanca was priced at a premium to Dated Brent and Oriente at a formula linked to West Texas Intermediate, but details of both deals remained confidential.
The tender asked for crude to be delivered November 6-10.
Traders said relatively good demand from European refiners for West African crudes thinned offers into the tender.
"(Enap) was expecting more offers from that region for light, sweet grades, but there were not that many sellers," a Latin American source said.
Market sources said the sellers of the African and Ecuadorian oil were Elf Aquitaine and Tripetrol, respectively.
